headline: 76mm rain in 6 hours: Dhaka hit by heavy rainfall and waterlogging
summary: Heavy rains since midnight have left several parts of the capital knee-deep in water, disrupting commutes and forcing some schools to postpone exams.
details: Dhaka experienced 76mm of rainfall within just six hours, according to the Meteorological Department. The continuous downpour since midnight has caused significant waterlogging in various parts of the city.

The flooding has severely disrupted the first working day of the week, leaving commuters and students struggling to reach their destinations. Some schools have been forced to postpone scheduled exams due to the weather.
Traffic has slowed significantly as vehicles struggle to navigate flooded roads. Daily wage earners have been most affected, continuing to work in the rain to ensure their livelihoods.
The Meteorological Department has warned of continued moderate to heavy rain in Dhaka and surrounding areas throughout the day.
The current weather pattern is attributed to a depression in the Bay of Bengal, increased activity of the monsoon winds, and variations in atmospheric pressure.

headline_marked: 2 dead, 4 wounded as [[shooter attacks Toronto salsa festival]]
headline: 2 dead, 4 wounded as shooter attacks Toronto salsa festival
summary: Police are searching for a suspect at large after a shooting at the 'Salsa on St. Clair' festival on Saturday.
details: Two people were killed and at least four others were wounded in a shooting at a salsa festival in Toronto on Saturday.
The victims were found at the scene with gunshot wounds, according to the most recent report by Toronto police.
The shooting took place at the 'Salsa on St. Clair' festival on St. Clair Avenue, as reported by an AFP journalist.
Ontario Premier Doug Ford expressed his devastation over the 'senseless violence' that claimed lives and injured others at the event.
A large police presence remains in the area as officers continue their investigation and search for the suspect, who remains at large.
This incident follows other recent shootings in Canada, including a fatal shooting in Montreal last month and a school shooting in Tumbler Ridge in February.
caption:
A festive celebration turned into a scene of chaos in Toronto as a gunman opened fire at a salsa festival, leaving 2 dead and 4 wounded.

Two people were killed and at least four others were wounded in a shooting at a salsa festival in Toronto on Saturday.

The victims were found at the scene with gunshot wounds, according to the most recent report by Toronto police.

The shooting took place at the 'Salsa on St. Clair' festival on St. Clair Avenue, as reported by an AFP journalist.

Ontario Premier Doug Ford expressed his devastation over the 'senseless violence' that claimed lives and injured others at the event.

A large police presence remains in the area as officers continue their investigation and search for the suspect, who remains at large.

This incident follows other recent shootings in Canada, including a fatal shooting in Montreal last month and a school shooting in Tumbler Ridge in February.
